home.section: Home, me and the shell (Phase 2 and slice 9)
home.when: home: unread channels with their first unread lines, mentions and replies waiting, pages recently edited in my spaces, my favorites, pages I own needing verification, the Librarian's last Monday note; a space owner's pending joins and unanswered questions; the admin's pending dispatches, published pages and trash size

activity.section: Home, me and the shell (Phase 2 and slice 9)
activity.when: my Activity: who mentioned me, replied to me, reacted to me, commented on my pages

saved.section: Home, me and the shell (Phase 2 and slice 9)
saved.when: the messages I saved (Later) and my reminders

notifications.section: Home, me and the shell (Phase 2 and slice 9)
notifications.when: what the bell holds, and to mark it read

trail.section: Home, me and the shell (Phase 2 and slice 9)
trail.when: my own activity trail, or a record's history

settings.section: Home, me and the shell (Phase 2 and slice 9)
settings.when: how I am told (email, text, which kinds, digest), my status line, my time zone

tokens.section: Home, me and the shell (Phase 2 and slice 9)
tokens.when: my own MCP tokens: mint one, revoke one

space-list.when: the spaces as cards by kind: mine, open ones to join, closed ones to request; the private ones only as a member

space-add.when: to make a space: name, icon, kind, description, levels, wiki

space-view.when: a space's home: description, its sections with root pages, its channels, its members with agents marked, the wiki's status when it is one, Join or Request

space-edit.when: to change a space's name, icon, description, kind, default levels, wiki setting

space-members.when: who is in the space and who owns it; add a member, a department's members or an agent; make an owner; remove

space-sections.when: the sidebar's sections of the space and their order; move root pages between them

space-requests.when: the pending requests to join a closed space, to approve or decline

space-templates.when: the templates of this space and the workspace's: open one, apply one, publish a page as a template

page-list.section: Pages: the tree, sharing, the wiki, the trash, templates (slice 2)
page-list.when: the pages I can see, newest edited first, by space; a search by title

page-add.section: Pages: the tree, sharing, the wiki, the trash, templates (slice 2)
page-add.when: to make a page: title, icon, where (a space or a parent page, or private), a template

page-view.section: Pages: the tree, sharing, the wiki, the trash, templates (slice 2)
page-view.when: the page: for a reader the rendered tree, breadcrumb, icon and cover, properties when a row, comments; for an editor the same page editable (slice 3); the page menu — Share, Publish, Lock, Verify, Favorite, Move, Duplicate, Export, History, Trash

page-edit.section: Pages: the tree, sharing, the wiki, the trash, templates (slice 2)
page-edit.when: to change a page's title, icon, cover (the body is edited in place on the page)

page-share.section: Pages: the tree, sharing, the wiki, the trash, templates (slice 2)
page-share.when: who can see the page and why: the inherited principals, the explicit ones, their levels; add a member, a department, a guest; restrict; the public link's state

page-move.section: Pages: the tree, sharing, the wiki, the trash, templates (slice 2)
page-move.when: to move a page under another page, to a space's root, or to my private pages

page-history.section: Pages: the tree, sharing, the wiki, the trash, templates (slice 2)
page-history.when: the page's versions: open one, compare two, restore one (slice 3 fills the diff)

page-publish.section: Pages: the tree, sharing, the wiki, the trash, templates (slice 2)
page-publish.when: to publish the page to the web: subpages yes or no, noindex, a database's layout; the link; rotate; unpublish

page-trash.section: Pages: the tree, sharing, the wiki, the trash, templates (slice 2)
page-trash.when: my trash (the admin's: everyone's): restore or purge; when each is purged

template-list.section: Pages: the tree, sharing, the wiki, the trash, templates (slice 2)
template-list.when: the templates gallery: the workspace's and my spaces'; apply one

wiki-view.section: Pages: the tree, sharing, the wiki, the trash, templates (slice 2)
wiki-view.when: a wiki space's status: every page with its owner and verification, the expired first; stale, orphaned, duplicated, broken (slice 6 fills the reports)

page-version.section: The block editor — THE FIRST EXEMPLAR (slice 3)
page-version.when: one version of the page as it was, with a diff against the current page or another version

channel-browse.section: Channels and messages — THE SECOND EXEMPLAR (slice 4)
channel-browse.when: the channels of my spaces: the ones I follow and the ones I can join, by space; archived apart

channel-add.section: Channels and messages — THE SECOND EXEMPLAR (slice 4)
channel-add.when: to make a channel in a space: name, kind, topic, purpose

channel-view.section: Channels and messages — THE SECOND EXEMPLAR (slice 4)
channel-view.when: the channel: messages newest at the bottom, day dividers, the unread line, threads collapsed, reactions, pins, the composer; polling while open

channel-edit.section: Channels and messages — THE SECOND EXEMPLAR (slice 4)
channel-edit.when: to change a channel's name, topic, purpose, kind (public or private), retention

channel-members.section: Channels and messages — THE SECOND EXEMPLAR (slice 4)
channel-members.when: who is in a private channel or follows a public one; add a member or a guest; remove

channel-pins.section: Channels and messages — THE SECOND EXEMPLAR (slice 4)
channel-pins.when: what is pinned and bookmarked in the channel

thread-view.section: Channels and messages — THE SECOND EXEMPLAR (slice 4)
thread-view.when: a thread: the first message and every reply, in order; reply; also send to channel

dm-list.section: Channels and messages — THE SECOND EXEMPLAR (slice 4)
dm-list.when: my direct and group messages with their last lines and unread counts

dm-new.section: Channels and messages — THE SECOND EXEMPLAR (slice 4)
dm-new.when: to start a direct or group message: a people picker that finds or makes the conversation

dm-view.section: Channels and messages — THE SECOND EXEMPLAR (slice 4)
dm-view.when: a direct or group message, read and answered like a channel; a DM to an agent shows "agent" and its thinking state

scheduled-list.section: Channels and messages — THE SECOND EXEMPLAR (slice 4)
scheduled-list.when: my scheduled messages, to change or cancel

reminder-list.section: Channels and messages — THE SECOND EXEMPLAR (slice 4)

database-list.when: the databases in my spaces as cards with their row counts

database-view.when: a database through its views: the tabs; the table with inline editing, add a row, hide or show properties, filters, sorts, groups; the board with drag between columns; the gallery; the list; the calendar; the timeline; a row opens as a page

database-schema.when: the properties: add, rename, change type where lossless, options, a relation's target and whether two-way, a rollup's source and function, a unique id's prefix; remove one

view-add.when: to add a view: name, layout, the properties it needs

view-edit.when: to change a view's name, layout, filter, sort, group, visible properties, card settings

row-view.when: one row as a page: its properties in a panel, its body below (the editor, slice 3)

search.section: Notifications, search and the wiki's reports (slice 6)
search.when: to find something across pages, rows, messages and comments, with the modifiers as chips; results grouped, the match in context

wiki-report.section: Notifications, search and the wiki's reports (slice 6)
wiki-report.when: the wiki's reports for a space: expired, unverified, stale, orphans, broken links, duplicates; nudge an owner

agent-list.when: the agents that are members here, their spaces and channels, their last reply, their pending and failed dispatches — read-only; hiring and grants link to the kernel

dispatch-list.when: every dispatch: pending, running, answered, failed; retry a failed one

proposal-list.when: the Librarian's proposals: accept or dismiss each

connection-list.when: which sibling applications read what of ours (the two shares) and when — the kernel's facts, read-only

import.section: The worker, imports, exports and retention (slice 8)
import.when: to import: a Markdown file or zip, a Notion export zip, a CSV into a database; a preview; the log of past imports

export-list.section: The worker, imports, exports and retention (slice 8)
export-list.when: my exports (the admin's: everyone's): make one, download one before it expires

admin-settings.when: the workspace's settings: business name, default space kind and levels, snapshot interval, version and trash retention, stale days, unanswered hours, verification default, the attachment limit, embed hosts, public pages noindex, digest hour, week start, time zone, group DM size, away minutes, the admin channel

admin-spaces.when: every space, the private ones marked (opening one is logged `space.admin_view`); archive, restore, delete

admin-published.when: every published page, its views and last opened; rotate or unpublish

admin-retention.when: every channel's retention and the version and trash retentions

admin-trash.when: everyone's trash: restore, purge, purge all
